title: Personal taste and willingness to recommend
summary: This topic combines comments about recommending the car, subjective taste in features, and phone-like controls, with many fragments too brief to determine a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention recommending the car to others, admiration from onlookers, and one favorable framing of BMW's smartphone-style approach.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the ownership experience left a bad taste.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments refer to differing personal preferences, dislike of artificial engine noise or phone dependence, cost limiting recommendation, and possible concerns about power, but the short excerpts are insufficient to confirm clear sentiment in several cases.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes several loosely related subjects, including recommendation, feature preferences, artificial engine noise, phone integration, cost, and power, rather than one single issue.
Most sampled fragments are very short or lack context, so sentiment and the exact feature being discussed are often unclear.
The examples are stratified samples and are not representative estimates of the full owner population.
